insnare.definition:
v. t. To catch in a snare; to entrap; to take by artificial
   means.
v. t. To take by wiles, stratagem, or deceit; to involve in
   difficulties or perplexities; to seduce by artifice; to inveigle; to
   allure; to entangle.
insnare.translation: v. 落于陷阱, 诱入圈套

insnared.translation: v. 落于陷阱, 诱入圈套( insnare的过去式和过去分词 )

insnaring.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Insnare
insnaring.translation: v. 落于陷阱, 诱入圈套( insnare的现在分词 )
